```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(IOBR)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)

# Force dplyr functions to take priority
library(conflicted)
conflict_prefer("select", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("rename", "dplyr")
conflict_prefer("intersect", "base"); conflict_prefer("setdiff", "base"); conflict_prefer("union", "base")

# ── Step 2: Verify LM22 is available ─────────────────────────────────────
# Check if LM22 loads correctly
tryCatch({
  lm22_test <- get("lm22", envir = asNamespace("IOBR"))
  cat("LM22 loaded successfully:", nrow(lm22_test), "genes x",
      ncol(lm22_test), "cell types\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("LM22 still not found — trying manual load\n")
})
library(IOBR)
#BiocManager::install("IOBR/IOBR")
# ── Manual LM22 fix ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Download LM22 from GitHub directly
lm22_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IOBR/IOBR/master/data/lm22.rda"
if (!file.exists("lm22.rda")) download.file(lm22_url, destfile = "lm22.rda", mode = "wb")
load("lm22.rda")

# Inject into IOBR namespace
# (older IOBR versions only; IOBR >= 2.x loads LM22 itself via load_data("lm22"))
if (exists("lm22", envir = asNamespace("IOBR"), inherits = FALSE)) assignInNamespace("lm22", lm22, ns = "IOBR")

# Verify
cat("LM22 dimensions:", nrow(lm22), "genes x", ncol(lm22), "cell types\n")
print(colnames(lm22))

# ── 1. Load risk scores ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
luad <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv")
lusc <- read.csv("TCGA_LUSC_risk_scores_3mir.csv")

# Combine LUAD + LUSC
nsclc_risk <- bind_rows(
  luad %>% mutate(cancer_type = "LUAD"),
  lusc %>% mutate(cancer_type = "LUSC")
)

cat("Total NSCLC patients:", nrow(nsclc_risk), "\n")
cat("High:", sum(nsclc_risk$RiskGroup == "High"),
    "Low:", sum(nsclc_risk$RiskGroup == "Low"), "\n")

# ── 2. Download LUAD mRNA (first run only) ────────────────────────────────
if (!file.exists("TCGA_LUAD_mrna.rds")) {
query_luad_mrna <- GDCquery(
  project       = "TCGA-LUAD",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type     = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
  sample.type   = "Primary Tumor"
)
GDCdownload(query_luad_mrna)
luad_mrna <- GDCprepare(query_luad_mrna)
saveRDS(luad_mrna, "TCGA_LUAD_mrna.rds")
}

# ── 3. Download LUSC mRNA (first run only) ────────────────────────────────
if (!file.exists("TCGA_LUSC_mrna.rds")) {
query_lusc_mrna <- GDCquery(
  project       = "TCGA-LUSC",
  data.category = "Transcriptome Profiling",
  data.type     = "Gene Expression Quantification",
  workflow.type = "STAR - Counts",
  sample.type   = "Primary Tumor"
)
GDCdownload(query_lusc_mrna)
lusc_mrna <- GDCprepare(query_lusc_mrna)
saveRDS(lusc_mrna, "TCGA_LUSC_mrna.rds")
}

# ── Load pre-downloaded TCGA mRNA data ────────────────────────────────────
luad_mrna <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_mrna.rds")
lusc_mrna <- readRDS("TCGA_LUSC_mrna.rds")

# ── 4. Extract TPM + convert to gene symbol ───────────────────────────────
convert_to_symbol <- function(se, assay_name = "tpm_unstrand") {
  cat("Available assays:", assayNames(se), "\n")
  tpm_mat    <- assay(se, assay_name)
  gene_info  <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
  symbol_col <- grep("gene_name|gene_symbol",
                      names(gene_info), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  rownames(tpm_mat) <- gene_info[[symbol_col]]
  tpm_df     <- as.data.frame(tpm_mat)
  tpm_df     <- tpm_df[!duplicated(rownames(tpm_df)) &
                         !is.na(rownames(tpm_df)) &
                         rownames(tpm_df) != "", ]
  return(as.matrix(tpm_df))
}

luad_tpm <- convert_to_symbol(luad_mrna)
lusc_tpm <- convert_to_symbol(lusc_mrna)

# ── 5. Combine mRNA matrices ──────────────────────────────────────────────
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(luad_tpm), rownames(lusc_tpm))
nsclc_tpm    <- cbind(luad_tpm[common_genes, ],
                       lusc_tpm[common_genes, ])

cat("Combined mRNA:", nrow(nsclc_tpm), "genes x", ncol(nsclc_tpm), "samples\n")

# ── 6. Match mRNA samples to risk score using 12-char case ID ─────────────
col_case12    <- substr(colnames(nsclc_tpm), 1, 12)
matched_idx   <- col_case12 %in% nsclc_risk$case_id
nsclc_tpm_matched <- nsclc_tpm[, matched_idx]

# Align risk_df to matched sample order
matched_case12    <- col_case12[matched_idx]
risk_matched      <- nsclc_risk[match(matched_case12, nsclc_risk$case_id), ]

cat("Matched samples:", ncol(nsclc_tpm_matched), "\n")
cat("High:", sum(risk_matched$RiskGroup == "High"),
    "Low:", sum(risk_matched$RiskGroup == "Low"), "\n")

# ── 7. Run CIBERSORT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cibersort_res <- deconvo_tme(
  eset    = nsclc_tpm_matched,
  method  = "cibersort",
  arrays  = FALSE,
  perm    = 100
)

write.csv(cibersort_res, "CIBERSORT_raw_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("CIBERSORT complete:", nrow(cibersort_res), "samples\n")

# ── 8. Merge CIBERSORT with risk groups ───────────────────────────────────
cibersort_res$case_id <- substr(cibersort_res$ID, 1, 12)

merged <- merge(cibersort_res,
                risk_matched[, c("case_id", "RiskGroup", "cancer_type")],
                by = "case_id")

write.csv(merged, "CIBERSORT_with_riskgroup.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Merged samples:", nrow(merged), "\n")

# ── 9. Get immune cell columns ────────────────────────────────────────────
immune_cols <- grep("CIBERSORT", names(cibersort_res), value = TRUE)
immune_cols <- immune_cols[!immune_cols %in% 
                             c("CIBERSORT_P_value", 
                               "CIBERSORT_Correlation",
                               "CIBERSORT_RMSE")]
cat("Immune cell types detected:", length(immune_cols), "\n")

# ── 10. Wilcoxon test per cell type ───────────────────────────────────────
wilcox_results <- lapply(immune_cols, function(cell) {
  high_vals <- merged[[cell]][merged$RiskGroup == "High"]
  low_vals  <- merged[[cell]][merged$RiskGroup == "Low"]
  test      <- wilcox.test(high_vals, low_vals)
  data.frame(
    Cell_Type  = gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", cell),
    p_value    = test$p.value,
    mean_High  = mean(high_vals),
    mean_Low   = mean(low_vals)
  )
})


wilcox_df <- do.call(rbind, wilcox_results) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj       = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    Significant = ifelse(p_adj < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    Direction   = ifelse(mean_High > mean_Low, 
                          "Higher in High", "Higher in Low")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# ── Fix Cell_Type names in wilcox_df to match immune_long ─────────────────
wilcox_df$Cell_Type <- gsub("_", " ", wilcox_df$Cell_Type)

# ── Define plot cells ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sig_cells  <- wilcox_df$Cell_Type[wilcox_df$p_adj < 0.05]
top8_cells <- wilcox_df$Cell_Type[1:8]

plot_cells <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) sig_cells else top8_cells
plot_title <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) {
  "Significant Immune Cell Types — High vs Low Risk (TCGA NSCLC)"
} else {
  "Top 8 Immune Cell Types — High vs Low Risk (TCGA NSCLC)"
}

cat("Plotting", length(plot_cells), "cell types\n")

print(wilcox_df)
write.csv(wilcox_df, "CIBERSORT_wilcox_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ── 11. Long format for plotting ──────────────────────────────────────────
immune_long <- merged %>%
  dplyr::select(case_id, RiskGroup, cancer_type, all_of(immune_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(immune_cols),
               names_to  = "Cell_Type",
               values_to = "Fraction") %>%
  mutate(Cell_Type = gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", Cell_Type),
         Cell_Type = gsub("_", " ", Cell_Type))

# ── Plot 11 significant cell types ───────────────────────────────────────
p_immune <- immune_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cell_Type %in% plot_cells) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RiskGroup, y = Fraction, fill = RiskGroup)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Cell_Type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Significant Immune Cell Types — High vs Low Risk (TCGA NSCLC)",
       x = NULL, y = "Cell Fraction") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

print(p_immune)
ggsave("CIBERSORT_significant_cells.png", p_immune, 
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# ── Also print full wilcox table for interpretation ───────────────────────
cat("\n--- All significant cell types (FDR < 0.05) ---\n")
print(wilcox_df[wilcox_df$p_adj < 0.05, 
                c("Cell_Type", "p_value", "p_adj", "mean_High", "mean_Low", "Direction")])

# ── 12. Boxplot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sig_cells <- wilcox_df$Cell_Type[wilcox_df$p_adj < 0.05]

p_sig <- immune_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cell_Type %in% sig_cells) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RiskGroup, y = Fraction, fill = RiskGroup)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
  facet_wrap(~Cell_Type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Significant Immune Cell Differences — High vs Low Risk (TCGA NSCLC)",
       x = NULL, y = "Cell Fraction") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

print(p_sig)
ggsave("CIBERSORT_significant_cells.png", p_sig, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# ── 13. Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
heatmap_data <- merged %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(immune_cols), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  column_to_rownames("RiskGroup") %>%
  t()

rownames(heatmap_data) <- gsub("CIBERSORT_", "", rownames(heatmap_data))
rownames(heatmap_data) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(heatmap_data))

pheatmap(heatmap_data,
         scale        = "row",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color        = colorRampPalette(c("#4E79A7", "white", "#E15759"))(50),
         main         = "Immune Cell Fractions — High vs Low Risk (TCGA NSCLC)",
         fontsize_row = 9,
         filename     = "CIBERSORT_heatmap.png",
         width        = 7,
         height       = 8)

# ── 14. Stacked bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
stack_data <- immune_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup, Cell_Type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_fraction = mean(Fraction), .groups = "drop")

p_stack <- ggplot(stack_data,
                   aes(x = RiskGroup, y = mean_fraction, fill = Cell_Type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Immune Composition — High vs Low Risk (TCGA NSCLC)",
       x = "Risk Group", y = "Mean Fraction", fill = "Cell Type") +
  theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))

print(p_stack)
ggsave("CIBERSORT_composition_bar.png", p_stack, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)



# ── Save right after deconvo_tme completes ────────────────────────────────
saveRDS(cibersort_res, "CIBERSORT_raw_results.rds")
write.csv(cibersort_res, "CIBERSORT_raw_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Also save the merged object
saveRDS(merged, "CIBERSORT_merged.rds")
write.csv(merged, "CIBERSORT_merged.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved successfully\n")
```

#seperate LUAD and LUSC
```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(IOBR)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHARED FUNCTIONS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

convert_to_symbol <- function(se, assay_name = "tpm_unstrand") {
  tpm_mat    <- assay(se, assay_name)
  gene_info  <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
  symbol_col <- grep("gene_name|gene_symbol",
                      names(gene_info), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  rownames(tpm_mat) <- gene_info[[symbol_col]]
  tpm_df <- as.data.frame(tpm_mat)
  tpm_df <- tpm_df[!duplicated(rownames(tpm_df)) &
                     !is.na(rownames(tpm_df)) &
                     rownames(tpm_df) != "", ]
  return(as.matrix(tpm_df))
}

match_samples <- function(tpm_mat, risk_df) {
  col_case12   <- substr(colnames(tpm_mat), 1, 12)
  matched_idx  <- col_case12 %in% risk_df$case_id
  tpm_matched  <- tpm_mat[, matched_idx]
  risk_matched <- risk_df[match(col_case12[matched_idx], risk_df$case_id), ]
  cat("Matched samples:", ncol(tpm_matched), "\n")
  cat("High:", sum(risk_matched$RiskGroup == "High"),
      "Low:",  sum(risk_matched$RiskGroup == "Low"), "\n")
  return(list(tpm = tpm_matched, risk = risk_matched))
}

run_wilcox <- function(merged, immune_cols, label) {
  results <- lapply(immune_cols, function(cell) {
    high_vals <- merged[[cell]][merged$RiskGroup == "High"]
    low_vals  <- merged[[cell]][merged$RiskGroup == "Low"]
    test      <- wilcox.test(high_vals, low_vals)
    data.frame(
      Cell_Type = cell,
      p_value   = test$p.value,
      mean_High = mean(high_vals),
      mean_Low  = mean(low_vals)
    )
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, results) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      p_adj       = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      Significant = ifelse(p_adj < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
      Direction   = ifelse(mean_High > mean_Low,
                            "Higher in High", "Higher in Low")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_adj)

  # Clean names after stats
  df$Cell_Type <- gsub("_", " ", df$Cell_Type)

  write.csv(df, paste0("CIBERSORT_wilcox_", label, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n--- Significant cell types (FDR<0.05):", label, "---\n")
  print(df[df$p_adj < 0.05,
           c("Cell_Type", "p_value", "p_adj", "mean_High", "mean_Low", "Direction")])
  return(df)
}

make_all_plots <- function(merged, wilcox_df, immune_cols, label) {

  # Long format
  immune_long <- merged %>%
    dplyr::select(case_id, RiskGroup, all_of(immune_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(immune_cols),
                        names_to  = "Cell_Type",
                        values_to = "Fraction") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cell_Type = gsub("_", " ", Cell_Type))

  risk_colors <- c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")

  # --- Boxplot ---
  sig_cells  <- wilcox_df$Cell_Type[wilcox_df$p_adj < 0.05]
  plot_cells <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) sig_cells else wilcox_df$Cell_Type[1:8]
  plot_title <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) {
    paste("Significant Immune Cell Types — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")")
  } else {
    paste("Top 8 Immune Cell Types — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")")
  }

  p_box <- immune_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(Cell_Type %in% plot_cells) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = RiskGroup, y = Fraction, fill = RiskGroup)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.4) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif", size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~Cell_Type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = risk_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL, y = "Cell Fraction") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

  print(p_box)
  ggsave(paste0("CIBERSORT_boxplot_", label, ".png"),
         p_box, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

  # --- Heatmap ---
  heatmap_data <- merged %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(immune_cols), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("RiskGroup") %>%
    t()

  rownames(heatmap_data) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(heatmap_data))

  pheatmap(heatmap_data,
           scale        = "row",
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           color        = colorRampPalette(c("#4E79A7", "white", "#E15759"))(50),
           main         = paste("Immune Cell Fractions — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")"),
           fontsize_row = 9,
           filename     = paste0("CIBERSORT_heatmap_", label, ".png"),
           width = 7, height = 8)

  # --- Stacked bar ---
  stack_data <- immune_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup, Cell_Type) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_fraction = mean(Fraction), .groups = "drop")

  p_stack <- ggplot(stack_data,
                     aes(x = RiskGroup, y = mean_fraction, fill = Cell_Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("Immune Composition — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")"),
         x = "Risk Group", y = "Mean Fraction", fill = "Cell Type") +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))

  print(p_stack)
  ggsave(paste0("CIBERSORT_stackbar_", label, ".png"),
         p_stack, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  cat("All plots saved for", label, "\n")
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LUAD
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n========== LUAD ==========\n")

luad_mrna <- readRDS("TCGA_LUAD_mrna.rds")
luad_risk <- read.csv("TCGA_LUAD_risk_scores_3mir.csv")

luad_tpm     <- convert_to_symbol(luad_mrna)
luad_matched <- match_samples(luad_tpm, luad_risk)

# Run CIBERSORT
luad_cib_res <- deconvo_tme(
  eset   = luad_matched$tpm,
  method = "cibersort",
  arrays = FALSE,
  perm   = 100
)

# Save immediately
saveRDS(luad_cib_res, "CIBERSORT_raw_LUAD.rds")
write.csv(luad_cib_res, "CIBERSORT_raw_LUAD.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("CIBERSORT LUAD saved\n")

# Merge with risk group
luad_cib_res$case_id <- substr(luad_cib_res$ID, 1, 12)
luad_merged <- merge(luad_cib_res,
                      luad_matched$risk[, c("case_id", "RiskGroup")],
                      by = "case_id")

saveRDS(luad_merged, "CIBERSORT_merged_LUAD.rds")
write.csv(luad_merged, "CIBERSORT_merged_LUAD.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Get immune cols
immune_cols_luad <- grep("CIBERSORT", names(luad_cib_res), value = TRUE)
immune_cols_luad <- immune_cols_luad[!immune_cols_luad %in%
                                       c("CIBERSORT_P_value",
                                         "CIBERSORT_Correlation",
                                         "CIBERSORT_RMSE")]

# Wilcox + plots
luad_wilcox <- run_wilcox(luad_merged, immune_cols_luad, "LUAD")
make_all_plots <- function(merged, wilcox_df, immune_cols, label) {

  # Long format
  immune_long <- merged %>%
    dplyr::select(case_id, RiskGroup, all_of(immune_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(immune_cols),
                        names_to  = "Cell_Type",
                        values_to = "Fraction") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cell_Type = gsub("_", " ", Cell_Type))

  risk_colors <- c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")

  # --- Boxplot ---
  sig_cells  <- wilcox_df$Cell_Type[wilcox_df$p_adj < 0.05]
  plot_cells <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) sig_cells else wilcox_df$Cell_Type[1:8]
  plot_title <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) {
    paste("Significant Immune Cell Types — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")")
  } else {
    paste("Top 8 Immune Cell Types (nominal p) — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")")
  }

  p_box <- immune_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(Cell_Type %in% plot_cells) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = RiskGroup, y = Fraction, fill = RiskGroup)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.4) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~Cell_Type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = risk_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = NULL, y = "Cell Fraction") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          strip.text      = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
          plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

  print(p_box)
  ggsave(paste0("CIBERSORT_boxplot_", label, ".png"),
         p_box, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)

  # --- Heatmap ---
  heatmap_data <- merged %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(immune_cols), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("RiskGroup") %>%
    t()

  rownames(heatmap_data) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(heatmap_data))

  # ── Fix: remove rows with zero variance (cause NA after scaling) ─────────
  row_sd <- apply(heatmap_data, 1, sd)
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[row_sd > 0, ]
  cat("Rows removed due to zero variance:", sum(row_sd == 0), "\n")
  cat("Rows remaining for heatmap:", nrow(heatmap_data), "\n")

  # ── Fix: remove any remaining NA/Inf rows ────────────────────────────────
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[complete.cases(heatmap_data), ]
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[!apply(heatmap_data, 1, function(x) any(is.infinite(x))), ]

  pheatmap(heatmap_data,
           scale        = "row",
           cluster_cols = FALSE,
           color        = colorRampPalette(c("#4E79A7", "white", "#E15759"))(50),
           main         = paste("Immune Cell Fractions — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")"),
           fontsize_row = 9,
           filename     = paste0("CIBERSORT_heatmap_", label, ".png"),
           width = 7, height = 8)

  # --- Stacked bar ---
  stack_data <- immune_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup, Cell_Type) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_fraction = mean(Fraction), .groups = "drop")

  p_stack <- ggplot(stack_data,
                     aes(x = RiskGroup, y = mean_fraction, fill = Cell_Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("Immune Composition — High vs Low Risk (TCGA", label, ")"),
         x = "Risk Group", y = "Mean Fraction", fill = "Cell Type") +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"))

  print(p_stack)
  ggsave(paste0("CIBERSORT_stackbar_", label, ".png"),
         p_stack, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  cat("All plots saved for", label, "\n")
}

# ── Re-run for LUAD ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_all_plots(luad_merged, luad_wilcox, immune_cols_luad, "LUAD")
```

#individual boxplot 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)

# ── Colour palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RISK_COLORS <- c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")

# ── Helper: Cell_Type string → column name ────────────────────────────────
# Cell_Type in wilcox CSVs: "Macrophages M1 CIBERSORT"
# Column in merged CSV:     "Macrophages_M1_CIBERSORT"
# Fix: just replace spaces with underscores
cell_to_col <- function(cell_name) {
  gsub(" ", "_", cell_name)
}

# ── Helper: plot one cell type and save PNG ───────────────────────────────
plot_one_cell <- function(merged_df,
                          cell_name,
                          col_name,
                          title_main,
                          subtitle_text,
                          out_path) {

  plot_df <- data.frame(
    RiskGroup = merged_df$RiskGroup,
    Fraction  = merged_df[[col_name]]
  )

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = RiskGroup, y = Fraction, fill = RiskGroup)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.45,
                 colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.45, colour = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = RISK_COLORS) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title    = cell_name,
      subtitle = paste0(title_main,
                        if (nchar(subtitle_text) > 0)
                          paste0("   |   ", subtitle_text)
                        else ""),
      x = "Risk Group",
      y = "Cell Fraction"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, colour = "grey40"),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 11)
    )

  ggsave(out_path, p, width = 4.5, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)
  invisible(p)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  LOAD DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pooled_merged <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged.csv",          check.names = FALSE)
pooled_wilcox <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_wilcox_results.csv",  check.names = FALSE)
luad_merged   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged_LUAD.csv",     check.names = FALSE)
luad_wilcox   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_wilcox_LUAD.csv",     check.names = FALSE)
lusc_merged   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged_LUSC.csv",     check.names = FALSE)
lusc_wilcox   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_wilcox_LUSC.csv",     check.names = FALSE)

# Drop any NA rows (seen in LUAD wilcox)
pooled_wilcox <- pooled_wilcox[!is.na(pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type), ]
luad_wilcox   <- luad_wilcox  [!is.na(luad_wilcox$Cell_Type),   ]
lusc_wilcox   <- lusc_wilcox  [!is.na(lusc_wilcox$Cell_Type),   ]

# The 11 significant cells from the pooled run
pooled_sig_cells <- pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type[pooled_wilcox$p_adj < 0.05]
luad_sig_cells   <- luad_wilcox$Cell_Type  [luad_wilcox$p_adj   < 0.05]
lusc_sig_cells   <- lusc_wilcox$Cell_Type  [lusc_wilcox$p_adj   < 0.05]

cat("Pooled sig cells (n =", length(pooled_sig_cells), "):", pooled_sig_cells, "\n")
cat("LUAD   sig cells (n =", length(luad_sig_cells),   "):", luad_sig_cells,   "\n")
cat("LUSC   sig cells (n =", length(lusc_sig_cells),   "):", lusc_sig_cells,   "\n")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  OUTPUT DIRECTORIES
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
dir.create("Output_CIBERSORT_Pooled", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Output_CIBERSORT_LUAD",   showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Output_CIBERSORT_LUSC",   showWarnings = FALSE)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  POOLED NSCLC — one PNG per significant cell
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n--- Plotting Pooled NSCLC ---\n")

for (cell in pooled_sig_cells) {
  col <- cell_to_col(cell)

  if (!col %in% names(pooled_merged)) {
    cat("  [SKIP] column not found:", col, "\n")
    next
  }

  padj      <- pooled_wilcox$p_adj     [pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type == cell]
  dir_label <- pooled_wilcox$Direction [pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type == cell]
  sub_txt   <- sprintf("FDR = %.3f  |  %s Risk", padj,
                       ifelse(grepl("High", dir_label), "↑ High", "↑ Low"))

  # Remove trailing " CIBERSORT" for a cleaner display title
  display_name <- sub(" CIBERSORT$", "", cell)
  safe_name    <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", display_name)
  out_file     <- file.path("Output_CIBERSORT_Pooled",
                             paste0(safe_name, "_Pooled_NSCLC.png"))

  plot_one_cell(
    merged_df     = pooled_merged,
    cell_name     = display_name,
    col_name      = col,
    title_main    = "Pooled NSCLC (LUAD + LUSC)",
    subtitle_text = sub_txt,
    out_path      = out_file
  )
  cat("  Saved:", out_file, "\n")
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.  COHORT-SPECIFIC PLOTS (LUAD / LUSC)
#     - Plots own FDR < 0.05 cells
#     - Annotates ★ if also significant in pooled
#     - Falls back to top 8 nominal-p cells if none pass FDR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot_cohort <- function(merged_df, wilcox_df, cohort_label, out_dir, pooled_sig) {

  sig_cells  <- wilcox_df$Cell_Type[wilcox_df$p_adj < 0.05]
  plot_cells <- if (length(sig_cells) > 0) {
    sig_cells
  } else {
    cat("  No FDR<0.05 for", cohort_label, "— using top 8 nominal-p cells\n")
    wilcox_df$Cell_Type[1:min(8, nrow(wilcox_df))]
  }

  cat("\n--- Plotting", cohort_label, "(n =", length(plot_cells), "cells) ---\n")

  for (cell in plot_cells) {
    col <- cell_to_col(cell)

    if (!col %in% names(merged_df)) {
      cat("  [SKIP] column not found:", col, "\n")
      next
    }

    padj      <- wilcox_df$p_adj     [wilcox_df$Cell_Type == cell]
    dir_label <- wilcox_df$Direction [wilcox_df$Cell_Type == cell]

    sub_txt <- sprintf("FDR = %.3f  |  %s Risk", padj,
                       ifelse(grepl("High", dir_label), "↑ High", "↑ Low"))

    # Annotate if also significant in pooled NSCLC
    if (cell %in% pooled_sig) {
      sub_txt <- paste0(sub_txt, "  |  ★ Also sig. in Pooled NSCLC")
    }

    display_name <- sub(" CIBERSORT$", "", cell)
    safe_name    <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", display_name)
    out_file     <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(safe_name, "_", cohort_label, ".png"))

    plot_one_cell(
      merged_df     = merged_df,
      cell_name     = display_name,
      col_name      = col,
      title_main    = paste0("TCGA-", cohort_label),
      subtitle_text = sub_txt,
      out_path      = out_file
    )
    cat("  Saved:", out_file, "\n")
  }
}

plot_cohort(luad_merged, luad_wilcox, "LUAD",
            "Output_CIBERSORT_LUAD", pooled_sig_cells)

plot_cohort(lusc_merged, lusc_wilcox, "LUSC",
            "Output_CIBERSORT_LUSC", pooled_sig_cells)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5.  CROSS-COHORT OVERLAP SUMMARY TABLE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
summary_df <- data.frame(
  Cell_Type  = pooled_sig_cells,
  Sig_Pooled = "Yes",
  Sig_LUAD   = ifelse(pooled_sig_cells %in% luad_sig_cells, "Yes", "No"),
  Sig_LUSC   = ifelse(pooled_sig_cells %in% lusc_sig_cells, "Yes", "No"),
  Dir_Pooled = pooled_wilcox$Direction[match(pooled_sig_cells, pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type)],
  Dir_LUAD   = luad_wilcox$Direction  [match(pooled_sig_cells, luad_wilcox$Cell_Type)],

)

write.csv(summary_df, "CIBERSORT_overlap_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

print(summary_df)

# Final file counts
cat("\n=== OUTPUT FILE COUNTS ===\n")
for (d in c("Output_CIBERSORT_Pooled", "Output_CIBERSORT_LUAD", "Output_CIBERSORT_LUSC")) {
  cat(d, "->", length(list.files(d, pattern = "\\.png$")), "PNG files\n")
}
```

#heatmap
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  LOAD DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pooled_merged <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged.csv",         check.names = FALSE)
pooled_wilcox <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_wilcox_results.csv", check.names = FALSE)
luad_merged   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged_LUAD.csv",    check.names = FALSE)
luad_wilcox   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_wilcox_LUAD.csv",    check.names = FALSE)
lusc_merged   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged_LUSC.csv",    check.names = FALSE)
lusc_wilcox   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_wilcox_LUSC.csv",    check.names = FALSE)

# Drop NA rows
pooled_wilcox <- pooled_wilcox[!is.na(pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type), ]
luad_wilcox   <- luad_wilcox  [!is.na(luad_wilcox$Cell_Type),   ]
lusc_wilcox   <- lusc_wilcox  [!is.na(lusc_wilcox$Cell_Type),   ]

# Significant cell sets — drop NA entries
pooled_sig <- na.omit(pooled_wilcox$Cell_Type[pooled_wilcox$p_adj < 0.05])
luad_sig   <- na.omit(luad_wilcox$Cell_Type  [luad_wilcox$p_adj   < 0.05])
lusc_sig   <- na.omit(lusc_wilcox$Cell_Type  [lusc_wilcox$p_adj   < 0.05])

cat("Pooled sig:", length(pooled_sig), "\n")
cat("LUAD   sig:", length(luad_sig),   "\n")
cat("LUSC   sig:", length(lusc_sig),   "\n")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

cell_to_col <- function(cell_name) gsub(" ", "_", cell_name)

# Build mean-per-RiskGroup matrix (rows = cells, cols = High / Low)
build_mean_matrix <- function(merged_df, sig_cells) {
  cols <- cell_to_col(sig_cells)

  # Verify all columns exist
  missing <- cols[!cols %in% names(merged_df)]
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    cat("  [WARN] Missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cols      <- cols[cols %in% names(merged_df)]
    sig_cells <- sig_cells[cell_to_col(sig_cells) %in% cols]
  }

  mat <- merged_df %>%
    dplyr::select(RiskGroup, all_of(cols)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("RiskGroup") %>%
    t()                                      # rows = cell types, cols = High/Low

  # Clean row names: remove trailing " CIBERSORT" / "_CIBERSORT"
  rownames(mat) <- sub("_CIBERSORT$", "", rownames(mat))
  rownames(mat) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(mat))

  # Order columns: High then Low
  mat <- mat[, c("High", "Low"), drop = FALSE]

  return(mat)
}

# Draw and save a pheatmap
draw_heatmap <- function(mat, wilcox_df, sig_cells,
                         title, filename,
                         width = 7, height = NULL) {

  if (nrow(mat) == 0) {
    cat("  [SKIP] No rows for heatmap:", title, "\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Auto height: ~0.45 inches per row + 1.5 for margins
  if (is.null(height)) height <- max(4, nrow(mat) * 0.45 + 2)

  # Row annotation: direction + FDR
  # Remove NA sig_cells before building annotation
  sig_cells   <- na.omit(sig_cells)
  clean_cells <- sub(" CIBERSORT$", "", sig_cells)
  clean_cells <- gsub("_", " ", clean_cells)

  matched_idx <- match(sig_cells, wilcox_df$Cell_Type)

  row_ann <- data.frame(
    FDR       = cut(
      wilcox_df$p_adj[matched_idx],
      breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
      labels = c("<0.001", "0.001–0.01", "0.01–0.05", "≥0.05")
    ),
    row.names = clean_cells
  )

  # Keep only rows present in matrix (safety) and drop any NA row names
  row_ann <- row_ann[!is.na(rownames(row_ann)), , drop = FALSE]
  row_ann <- row_ann[rownames(row_ann) %in% rownames(mat), , drop = FALSE]
  row_ann <- row_ann[rownames(mat), , drop = FALSE]

  # Annotation colours
  ann_colors <- list(
    FDR = c("<0.001"     = "#7B2D8B",
            "0.001–0.01" = "#C45AB3",
            "0.01–0.05"  = "#F7B2D9",
            "≥0.05"      = "grey85")
  )

  # Column annotation: risk group colour
  col_ann <- data.frame(
    RiskGroup = colnames(mat),
    row.names = colnames(mat)
  )
  ann_colors$RiskGroup <- c("High" = "#E15759", "Low" = "#4E79A7")

  pheatmap(
    mat,
    scale            = "none",
    cluster_rows     = TRUE,
    cluster_cols     = FALSE,
    annotation_row   = row_ann,
    annotation_col   = col_ann,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    color            = colorRampPalette(
                         rev(brewer.pal(9, "RdBu")))(100),
    border_color     = "white",
    cellwidth        = 45,
    fontsize_row     = 10,
    fontsize_col     = 11,
    main             = title,
    filename         = filename,
    width            = width,
    height           = height
  )

  cat("  Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  POOLED NSCLC HEATMAP  (11 cells)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n--- Pooled NSCLC heatmap ---\n")

mat_pooled <- build_mean_matrix(pooled_merged, pooled_sig)

draw_heatmap(
  mat       = mat_pooled,
  wilcox_df = pooled_wilcox,
  sig_cells = pooled_sig,
  title     = "Immune Cell Fractions — High vs Low Risk\nPooled NSCLC (LUAD + LUSC)",
  filename  = "CIBERSORT_heatmap_Pooled_NSCLC.png"
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4.  LUAD HEATMAP  (own FDR < 0.05 cells)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n--- LUAD heatmap ---\n")

mat_luad <- build_mean_matrix(luad_merged, luad_sig)

draw_heatmap(
  mat       = mat_luad,
  wilcox_df = luad_wilcox,
  sig_cells = luad_sig,
  title     = "Immune Cell Fractions — High vs Low Risk\nTCGA-LUAD",
  filename  = "CIBERSORT_heatmap_LUAD.png"
)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5.  LUSC HEATMAP  (own FDR < 0.05 cells — Tregs + Macrophages M2)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cat("\n--- LUSC heatmap ---\n")

mat_lusc <- build_mean_matrix(lusc_merged, lusc_sig)

draw_heatmap(
  mat       = mat_lusc,
  wilcox_df = lusc_wilcox,
  sig_cells = lusc_sig,
  title     = "Immune Cell Fractions — High vs Low Risk\nTCGA-LUSC",
  filename  = "CIBERSORT_heatmap_LUSC.png",
  width     = 6.5,
  height    = 3.5      # only 2 rows, keep compact
)

cat("\nAll heatmaps done.\n")
```

#composition
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1.  LOAD DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pooled_merged <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged.csv",      check.names = FALSE)
luad_merged   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged_LUAD.csv", check.names = FALSE)
lusc_merged   <- read.csv("CIBERSORT_merged_LUSC.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# ── Technical columns to exclude ─────────────────────────────────────────
TECH_COLS <- c("RMSE_CIBERSORT", "Correlation_CIBERSORT", "P-value_CIBERSORT",
               # also catch any alternative naming variants
               "CIBERSORT_RMSE", "CIBERSORT_Correlation", "CIBERSORT_P_value",
               "P.value_CIBERSORT", "P-value CIBERSORT")

get_immune_cols <- function(df) {
  cols <- grep("CIBERSORT", names(df), value = TRUE)
  cols <- cols[!cols %in% TECH_COLS]
  return(cols)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2.  HELPER: build stacked bar plot
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
make_composition_plot <- function(merged_df, title, filename,
                                   width = 9, height = 6) {

  immune_cols <- get_immune_cols(merged_df)
  cat("Immune cell columns used (n =", length(immune_cols), "):\n")
  print(immune_cols)

  # Clean cell-type labels: remove _CIBERSORT suffix and underscores
  clean_labels <- sub("_CIBERSORT$", "", immune_cols)
  clean_labels <- gsub("_", " ", clean_labels)
  names(clean_labels) <- immune_cols          # named vector for recode

  # Long format → mean fraction per RiskGroup × Cell_Type
  stack_data <- merged_df %>%
    dplyr::select(RiskGroup, all_of(immune_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(immune_cols),
                        names_to  = "Cell_Type",
                        values_to = "Fraction") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Cell_Type = dplyr::recode(Cell_Type, !!!clean_labels)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(RiskGroup, Cell_Type) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_fraction = mean(Fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop")

  # Consistent colour palette (enough colours for 22 cell types)
  n_cells  <- length(unique(stack_data$Cell_Type))
  pal_base <- c(
    "#4E79A7","#F28E2B","#E15759","#76B7B2","#59A14F",
    "#EDC948","#B07AA1","#FF9DA7","#9C755F","#BAB0AC",
    "#1F77B4","#AEC7E8","#FFBB78","#2CA02C","#98DF8A",
    "#D62728","#FF9896","#9467BD","#C5B0D5","#8C564B",
    "#C49C94","#E377C2"
  )
  cell_colors <- setNames(
    rep(pal_base, length.out = n_cells),
    sort(unique(stack_data$Cell_Type))
  )

  p <- ggplot(stack_data,
              aes(x = RiskGroup, y = mean_fraction, fill = Cell_Type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.55,
             colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cell_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = "Risk Group",
      y     = "Mean Cell Fraction (%)",
      fill  = "Cell Type"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

  ggsave(filename, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  cat("  Saved:", filename, "\n")
  invisible(p)
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3.  PLOTS
```
